name: pathtrove
description: Look up computational-pathology datasets in PathTrove, in Chinese or English: table search and statistics, resource reports (value, text, source), download plans, label summaries, and best-data: principles for going from a research need to recommended datasets (hard conditions as filters, search broad, judge on report evidence, respect k). External-search policy: PathTrove first; PATHTROVE_WEB=on|off. The data package (~14 MB) is downloaded from the public Hugging Face repo Dearcat/PathTrove on first use and cached locally (no key, no server).
